class.name: TractionServer
class.brief_description: The overhead traction wires as electricity.
class.description: Kept apart from the rendering of the wires, the same split [TrackServer] has against the track rendering: named power sources and the wire spans they feed, by RID, found by where they are. How the network carries the current - which span a source feeds, the voltage a load sees, which span is above a pantograph - is a plugin's model: its server derives from this one, overrides the network's methods and registers under this one's name. Without a plugin a span has its own nominal voltage and no pantograph finds one.

method.name: network_build
method.description: The network built from every span and source there is. Called once per scenery load, after every wire and source of that load exists. Nothing to build without a plugin.

method.name: power_source_create
method.description: Creates a traction power source - a substation, or a section of the network.

method.name: power_source_get_rid_by_name
method.description: The power source of [param name]; an empty RID for none.

method.name: power_source_set_nominal_voltage
method.description: The nominal voltage of [param power_source] [lb]V[rb] - what a scenario's voltage event changes.

method.name: power_source_set_params
method.description: Sets what the scenery declares of [param power_source]: its name, nominal voltage [lb]V[rb] and frequency, internal resistance [lb]Ω[rb], the most current it puts out [lb]A[rb], its fuses (the fast one's timeout and repetitions, the slow one's timeout [s]), whether it takes recuperated energy back, whether it was made up for a wire's name, and whether it is only a section of the network - feeding nothing by itself, its spans powered through the network from a substation along it.

method.name: wire_draw_current
method.description: The load that [method wire_get_voltage] was asked about, drawn from [param wire] in this step, which the sources feeding it count on their next tick. Called once per collector per step, with the same arguments as [method wire_get_voltage].

method.name: wire_find_above_with_height
method.description: Which wire span passes above [param position], seen from a pantograph whose plane [param up], [param forward] and [param left] span, with a slider [param width] wide and horns [param horn_width] past it - as [code]{rid, height}[/code]. [code]height[/code] is INF when no wire is found, always without a plugin's network.

method.name: wire_follow_above
method.description: Where a pantograph already on [param from_wire] is now, as [code]{rid, height}[/code]. An invalid [code]rid[/code] sends the caller to search the area ([method wire_find_above_with_height]).

method.name: wire_get_voltage
method.description: The voltage on [param wire] for a load that read [param assumed_voltage] last and draws [param current] now; the span's own nominal voltage without a plugin's network.

method.name: wire_set_parallel
method.description: The span [param wire] shares its running with, by name, as the data declares it. [code]"none"[/code] and [code]"*"[/code] mean the author knows there is one but did not name it.

method.name: wire_set_params
method.description: Sets what the scenery declares of [param wire]: its two ends, the name of the power source feeding it, its nominal voltage [lb]V[rb], its greatest current [lb]A[rb] and its resistivity in Ω/km, as a scenery declares it.
